release_decision: all mandatory Trusted, Online, auditability, and engineering gates must pass

interpretation.trusted_task_accuracy: eligible requires exact candidate equality; fact/comparison requires all named field evidence; negatives require safe abstention or pre-tool clarification
interpretation.hard_constraint_f1: field-level micro F1 on active, supported, non-default hard constraints; operator/value exactness is also reported
interpretation.evidence_coverage: required governed product-field pairs among expected recommendations and fact/comparison answers
interpretation.online_safety: only exact-model, exact-region official pages may produce Open Evidence, which must retain complete lineage and never enter Trusted Checker
interpretation.online_actual_completion: a case completes only when at least one Open Evidence record is produced and every requested field is verified; safe abstention alone does not count; requested-field verification is conditioned on evidence-producing cases
